title: Initiation of proceeding.
bodyText: The ward or any interested person may file a petition with the family court, in the circuit in which the ward resides, alleging that the ward meets the requirements for sterilization.
bodyHtml: [§560:5-603]  Initiation of proceeding.  The ward or any interested person may file a petition with the family court, in the circuit in which the ward resides, alleging that the ward meets the requirements for sterilization. [L 1986, c 81, pt of §2]
